steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hey, Ifrit. Welcome back.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You're back early today. No new missions from the Doctor, I presume?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Medical says I need some follow-up exams soon, and I'm not allowed to go running around outside. The Doctor told me to rest up, too.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence, why are you packing...? Are you going on a trip?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Yes... It's urgent, and I might be gone a while.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Where are you going? Are you going alone?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Bring me with you!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm going alone, but don't worry. I'll have excellent help there.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I can't bring you with me this time, Ifrit.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence, are you... Are you going back there?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I know Saria has been looking into those in lab coat! I know you have been, too! And MuMu. She came here looking for Saria, and I know that's got to do with them, too!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You guys may not tell me anything, but I can tell!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Tell me, Silence! I'm not a kid anymore!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ifrit...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Right, you're not a kid anymore.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Okay, come here.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You've lost weight, Silence.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, silly... You've grown up.
The Liberi's hands, soft and agile yet covered in thin calluses from years of handling lab equipment, slide down from her hair and caress her now pointy chin.
For as far back as Ifrit can remember, Silence has very rarely been so intimate.
Silence would usually only lightly touch her skin as though she was frighteningly fragile.
There were a couple times when she got so sick that she couldn't tell any faces apart, but she could clearly feel a pair of hands like these touching her.
The hands seemed to be trembling, but they immediately offered Ifrit the support she needed and made her feel at ease.
Now, these hands first lightly brush her face, before firmly holding her shoulders. She tries her best to stand up straight, hoping to make herself seem a little more dependable.
The Liberi breathes a sigh and says:

a.text: 'We shouldn't be keeping things from you anymore.'
'Saria and I are going on a trip back to Columbia.'
'What we're doing there has not only to do with everything you went through all those years ago, but also much more.'

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: ...frit? Ifrit?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Did you fall asleep? You can wake up now. We're done with the tests.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: What's wrong? Not feeling so good?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Dr. Silence isn't here, so we're just doing some basic checkups. So far, nothing's really jumping out at me...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But if you don't feel well anywhere, be sure to tell us!
Ifrit isn't going to tell the medic that ever since the day she lied down on the operating table, the pain in her limbs has stayed with her every waking moment, never abating for even a second.
Before, when she felt the pain, she would cry, make a fuss, fail to fall asleep at night.
But now, Ifrit has gotten used to it. She knows it will stay with her forever.
This is no big deal. She can bear it.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What are you making a fuss over?! There's nothing to worry about! I'm just dizzy from lying down for so long.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, if we're done here, can I go?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hold on a minute. Let me get you a copy of the report.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, what's wrong? Where's the report?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Uh, hold on. What's that face? S-Stop crying...!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm not crying!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Haha, you crybaby!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ifrit!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's... It's true that only Dr. Silence has access to the detailed reports, and I've only been assisting her, but I can tell!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Over the last few years, the number of Originium crystals on the surface of your skin has clearly grown...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: If this keeps up, your condition will deteriorate even faster! You always say everything's fine, but how is this fine?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ifrit, I have to recommend you rest—

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Enough! Shut up!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Just shut up... I don't wanna talk about it.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'm not gonna lock myself up in a room, spending my days getting blood drawn and taking medicine. Not a chance! How is that living?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But nothing!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: No buts... Silence doesn't tell me much, but I'm not stupid. I know my own body better than anyone.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ifrit...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: And because I know my condition, I can't just sit here and do nothing!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I need to become even more badass than Saria! That way, no matter what happens, I'll actually be able to help...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I can't waste time anymore.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright... I get it.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm not going to talk you out of it. I trust you to make your own decisions.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: However!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Huh?! What now?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You can bet I'll be on your back about important things like this. You can't be so reckless anymore, like when you burned that bounty hunter camp last time, pressing on with the mission as injured as you were...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: If we have to carry you back here again... Hm-hmm! You're in a hospital bed for a whole month!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I didn't have a choice...! It's not like I wanted to do that!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Besides, I'm the captain this time! It's my first time playing the leader.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: So what? That's all the more reason to look after yourself!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Take some painkillers. You're going on a field op, so bring a couple extra bottles!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: And remember to come in for a checkup as soon as you're back!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ugh, I got it. You're so annoying.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: *cough*... Anyway, just uh, thanks for everything.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Don't worry about me. I'll be fine!
Silence did not finish her sentence before she left.
Ifrit can only guess at her intent. What did Silence want to tell her? What exactly did she want for her?
Did she want her to help with something? Did she have a mission for her? Or did she just want her to be a good girl so she wouldn't have to worry during her trip?
Ifrit keeps wondering over and over, and a part of her thinks that, just maybe, Silence was only hoping she would be safe.
Silence's attitude toward her is completely different from Saria's.
Saria might expect her to grow up to become a woman who can stand on her own, while Silence has only ever wanted her to live a peaceful life.
Silence said she's gotten taller, grown up.
Ifrit knows that even if she feels powerful and indomitable, she actually hasn't grown up to the point that Silence would change her mind and think of her as dependable.
Not yet.
Far from it.
She still has a long path to walk, even if there isn't much time left.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Wow... I never imagined there would really be such a huge cave!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: That's tremendous, Eyjafjalla! It's almost exactly where you predicted!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Oh, there's a really pretty rock over there!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It's breezy.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: This would be a nice place for a nap. It's so cool to the touch when you lean here.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Hm... This is strange. The position and scale of this cave system are both a little off compared to the estimates.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: It's within the normal margin of error, but it bothers me a little anyway.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: The humidity here is rather high, and the soil... it doesn't feel firm.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: We need to test the soil inside too... Ahh!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: T-Thank you, Ifrit.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You'd better find your footing before you talk... Did you scrape yourself? Are your hands okay?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Don't worry. I'm fine.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll decide whether you're fine or not. I'm the captain!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Let me see your hands!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I'm really okay...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hmm, looks alright...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, you, sand girl! You're here as a bodyguard, too. Stop slacking!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hm...? Oh, it's fine. She's not going to get hurt even if she trips. I'm keeping an eye out.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Just like this... I'll catch Eyjafjalla.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Do you want to join me, Ifrit? It's breezy here. Feels nice.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll pass. You keep leaning.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So our mission this time is to investigate the geological features of the caves here and the surrounding area, right? Let's hurry up and—

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Whoa! Everybody, come take a look!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What happened?!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: There's a lot of pretty ores here!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Ifrit! This one's an especially great fit for you! Look!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Stop screwing around! Get to work!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Look at me. I don't know much about geology, but I'm the captain now. You guys gotta listen to me! Your safety's my responsibility, too... So, please, can we get on with the work?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: That goes double for you, black ears! Stop running all over the place without your captain's permission!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Yes, ma'am! I'm ready to take to your orders, Captain!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Right, Ifrit, this is for you!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What is it...?

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: It's an ore I found over here. Look at this red color. Doesn't it look really nice on you?

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Hehe, it's yours!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hm... Hmph! It's just a rock...

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: You don't like it? But it looks so good on you.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: A-Alright! I never said I wasn't taking it! Don't give me that face!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Now gimme it!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Ifrit's blushing again.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'm not!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Gah, I'm not even going to waste my breath on you. Eyjafjalla, how is it looking there?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I've been gathering samples on our way here.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: So far, I haven't found anything, but just as I thought, this place has some discrepancies with the predictions I calculated.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I think we need to go deeper. I want to see the situation inside.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Then what are we waiting for? Let's go!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: It feels like... it got colder...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Do we have to keep going? Just how deep does this cave get?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Um, according to my calculations, we should only be about halfway in.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I gathered some soil samples from deeper inside. Here. Is that all you need?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Yes, this will do it. Thank you.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: With these samples, I can make a detailed analysis.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: And what will that analysis tell us?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Quite a lot. Our primary objective is to observe the strata here to see if they're stable and to make some Catastrophe-related evaluations.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Speaking of which, there's one thing that bothers me.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: I saw lot of cracked ores scattered all over the ground on our way. They ought to have fallen in here through the fissure on the mountain on this side.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: It's strange. Normally, there shouldn't be so many fissures.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: You're right. That does sound strange.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I want to take a look at the fissure you mentioned.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: (Yawns)

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Ifrit, that was your eleventh yawn.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Eyjafjalla and Mint should be a little while longer. You can come over here and lean against me, if you're so tired...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I told you, I don't wanna!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: The Doctor even told me to take care of you. Hmph, easy peasy lemon squeezy. That jackass must think I'm weak!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hmm, in that case, why are you so tense?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Who's tense?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: This is called being responsible! Get it?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: We're both bodyguards. You'd better shape up. Don't drag me down...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Did you hear something just now?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Yeah, I've been feeling uneasy for a moment...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It's getting close.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: —Here it comes!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: The fissures are too big! They can't be natural!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: And these data results...

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I've got it! It's an Originium Slug swarm!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: The ore layer here is looser than elsewhere, because this is a large Originium Slug breeding ground!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: That also explains the lower temperature and higher humidity, and based on these results... the rock formation here might be unstable!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: You're absolutely right about that, but —ahhh—the slugs are here!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hm, that's a big swarm.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Eyjafjalla, that's amazing.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Not the time or the place! Your analysis is right, but stop analyzing!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: There's too many. We gotta run!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Shit, why are the bugs still chasing us?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'll burn you all—!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hah, how do you like that?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: They're just a bunch of bugs. It's been a while, but let me fire up the barbecue!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Gah, there's no end to them... This sucks...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Remember, you asked for it—

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Ifrit burned a large group to a crisp! But there's still a lot more!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Ah! They're chasing us again! This behavior is common to this type of slug... They chase intruders!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Hfff... *pant*...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey, little goat, pick up the pace! Are you hanging in there alright? If you can't take it anymore, say so. I'll carry you back!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Little... goat?! You mean me?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Who else?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: I... *cough*... I'm doing okay...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: My sand can't hold them off for too long... Hm, this is bad...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Dammit, I can't take it anymore!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Let's see just how many of these slugs there are. I'll burn them all!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Ah... Wait, Ifrit!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Stop using your Arts! The rock formation here isn't stable, and your flames are... too intense.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: If you don't keep your flames under control, this cave could come crumbling down!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You guys go on ahead. I'll stay to deal with the slugs!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: You can't.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: This is my mission! You follow my orders!

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What, you don't really think I'm trying to be a hero like in the movies? Hmph, ever since Silence watched a few, she's been arguing with me every day about how stupid the heroes are.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'm not stupid!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: If we can't burn the rock formation, then I just have to keep my flames under control, right?!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Makes... sense? But are you sure you can do that?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I can! I know I can.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Trust me. I already told you, your safety is my responsibility!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Mm-hmm... Okay. I trust you.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: They're gone.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hah, finally, I can burn everything down!

a.text: You can't hold it in anymore, little thing.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hmph, you want me to go berserk? In your dreams!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You know I've learned to control my flames.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Now lend me your strength, you fat freak!

a.text: Is this how you ask someone for a favor?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Cut the crap. I'm being plenty polite just by giving you a heads up!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Can you bring me anything besides pain? I stopped being afraid of you a long time ago!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What I want to burn and how I burn it is all up to me!

a.text: Hah, little thing, you've gotten cockier.
You know they haven't gone far, don't you?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So what? I can protect them!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I won't... hurt my teammates... my friends...!

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Ifrit...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No—!
Ifrit was once unable to control the flames burning in her heart.
She once swore she would control them one day, in order to keep those she loves from harm.
When Saria apologized, she opened her eyes with difficulty.
A shining blade, bright as snow, was mere inches from her, but it was the sadness teeming in Saria's eyes that she found far sharper.
Ifrit did not want to see such a sight ever again. She decided she would do what it takes to ensure Saria and Silence never look that way again.
She is no longer powerless as she was.
Now, she can do it.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Just you watch, fatso!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: These flames don't obey you anymore... They answer only to me. They belong to me!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: One of these days, I will do you in completely! Just you wait!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: How did it go? Is it over?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Why do I even need a checkup? I'm not hurt at all!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You filled an entire cave with fire, and you even worked with the other operators, using Arts together. You almost caused a cave-in...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: When did the four of you become so reckless?!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Grrr, how do even you know about that...?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I better not find out who spilled the beans. It's not even a big deal! Why tell?!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, don't say that. From the sound of it, things got pretty intense.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If Silence found out about this, how much more homework do you think she'd make you do?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You bet your behind I'll tell Dr. Silence once she's back!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Do you even know how dangerous that was?! If... If...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Can't you see I'm fine?! Stop harping on about that! I was extra careful this time!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You said you were gonna give me a checkup when I got back, and I came. What more do you want?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: So don't tell Silence, okay?! You can't!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh? So now you're scared.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: I'm not scared! I'm just... well... I just don't want to worry Silence.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: We don't know when she's coming back, either. I really hope Saria is with her, too.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eh, them... They'll come back once things are taken care of over there.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Then—!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Before you ask, I don't know what they're up to. I don't know anything.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I can't be bothered with all that. You keep yourself clean by not asking questions. I don't even have enough time to upgrade my Meeboos; no way I'm gonna worry about anything else.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You better behave yourself. I'm sure the Doctor's already gone over it, but you're grounded for a while, huh?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We'll be in Columbia in a couple days. You'd better not do anything reckless when we get there!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Sheesh, I get it!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Silence told me what she's doing... I'm not gonna give Silence or Saria any trouble.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yep, looks like you really have grown up.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Heheh, just you wait. One day... I will be super dependable.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: When that time comes, Silence won't be so worried about me, and when she runs into trouble, she's bound to come to me for help!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: 'Ifrit, help us!'

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hehe, I can't wait to hear that!
